$comment: Live practice tuning. Edit and reload the Practice page; no rebuild needed. Missing keys fall back to defaults; invalid values are ignored with a console warning.

cues.$comment: Spoken positioning cues. holdMs: a cue must be the current one this long before it is spoken. cooldownMs: silence after any spoken cue. repeatSameMs: min gap before the same cue repeats. readyHoldMs: positioned must hold this long before 'Ready' (Ready ignores the cooldown).

readiness.$comment: nearSideMinVis/headMinVis: landmark visibility needed for 'whole body in frame' (near side only). fullBodyHoldMs: full body must hold this long. maxSideSeparation: shoulder/hip x-spread divided by torso height; at or below this counts as side-on. orientationWindow: recent frames voted on (~2 s at 30 fps). minOrientationAgreement: fraction of those frames that must agree.

latency.$comment: Pose-detection latency (capture → skeleton). model: 'auto' starts on the full model and switches to the faster 'lite' model once if the median latency over windowFrames (after warmupFrames) exceeds liteFallbackP50Ms. Force a model with 'full' or 'lite'.
